strategies.name: vwap_band_trend_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: With a directional bias, wait for price to run to the 1st/2nd VWAP std-dev band, then after it breaks/retests enter WITH the move (e.g. long once price pushed to band and held).
strategies.exit_summary: Use 2nd and 3rd std-dev bands as profit target; exit only via band targets (no explicit stop).

entry_sequence.action: say you might have a long idea for your session
as the New York session opens we are still right on Fair Value we start running up you might want to wait until the price has gone at least to the first if not the second standard deviation
after we broke it and tested it we can try our long trade

confluences.description: it's always needed to have a context behind your trading idea you're not just going to trade based off of vwap only
we've accumulated a bunch of orders below here and created volume below and see the vwap going down a little bit also

targets.description: you can use the second and third standard deviation as a Target
you can use the second and third standard deviation as a Target

instrument_classification.notes: Speaker frames it as a day-trading application of VWAP; references 'you as a day trader with five es contracts'. No specific chart timeframe stated for this setup.
